purpose: To provide a comprehensive introduction to VALORANT for new players, covering essential game mechanics, agents, maps, and tips to improve gameplay.
summary: This webpage is VALORANT's official beginner's guide, offering new players a comprehensive overview of the game's core elements. It covers Agents, game rounds, economy, weapons, maps, crucial tips, communication strategies, and settings, enhanced with video guides from community experts, aiming to help newcomers quickly grasp the game's fundamentals and start playing effectively.
